children: Muscat: Oman Air has launch its latest Global Sale. Until October 1, 2026, travelers can enjoy fares starting from RO35 across the airline’s global route network, alongside valuable savings on travel extras.
Valid on Business and Economy Class fares, both one-way and return, the sale also includes up to 50% off additional baggage allowance and up to 10% off preferred seat selection.
The offer is valid for travel between November 1, 2026 and March 8, 2027. The promotion does not apply to interline or codeshare flights.
